changes.title: Gifts shown one group at a time, with group buttons
changes.why: All the gifts sit in one very long scroll; one group per screen keeps each view complete and fits a laptop (rules 3c, 3s, video on filter chips).

changes.title: Each gift gets a clear price line and a plus button
changes.why: Tiles give no hint they can be added; a price beside a round add button says it (shop-page videos, rule 3s.17).

changes.title: Each line under What we make now leads somewhere
changes.why: Bespoke arrangements and add-ons promised something with no way to ask; each row now has a link, and the section fits one screen.

changes.title: Order page gets the same menu bar and a three step bar
changes.why: The order page had a different bar and one 2700 pixel page; rule 3k asks for one menu everywhere and orders in steps.

changes.title: Order list: search, group buttons, bigger photos, no sold-out items
changes.why: A very long list with tiny photos and gifts you cannot order; now find a gift fast and see it clearly (rule 3s, search video).

changes.title: Every line in your order has a remove button
changes.why: A wrong gift could only be removed by tapping minus down to zero; rule 3k asks for a bin on every line. The menu shows the count.

changes.title: Last step names what happens, with the total
changes.why: The button always read the same; now it says Continue, then Send order on WhatsApp, $202, with a tick line that nothing is paid here (3j, 3s.17).

changes.title: A short confirmation appears when a gift is added
changes.why: Adding gave no feedback beyond a small number change; a dark bar says what was added and leaves by itself (rule 3s, button-feedback video).

changes.title: A real footer with pages, WhatsApp, email and hours
changes.why: The footer only said where we are; visitors now find the pages and every way to reach us on both pages (rule 3k.3).

questions: Can you send a short story about the shop and who wraps the gifts, so we can add an About page and a photo of you at work?
Do you also want prices in shekels, since most buyers are in Israel and the catalogue is in dollars?
What does delivery cost and which areas do you deliver to, and how many days ahead should someone order?
Three gifts are all called Bottle Opener at different prices: can you give each a clearer name or one line saying what is in it?
Do you offer any promise such as a redo or refund if a gift arrives damaged, to show beside the order button?
Is any gift set cheaper than its parts bought separately, so we can show the saving in money?
checks_now: Real site: no glitches on the home page; the collection section is 2755px and the order page section 2736px (too tall for one screen), What we make is 851px; the order button has no hover state while disabled; order-page photo 404s only occur because the local server lacks the /pages/ path.
